_comment: Mechanism-layer paths that may name models (hooks/model_name_guard.py). Globs are relative to .claude/. Each entry names what makes the file a measurement or a model-fact home; a file that only needs a model at run time resolves it from the registry instead.

exemptions.justification: A campaign definition names the arm it runs; the arm is the measured variable.
The reference pin names the measured arm that cleared task readiness; the arm is a measurement fact.
Sealed cells, calibration sets and rulings are measurement records keyed by the arm they scored.
Extracted deliverables of a measured arm, kept as scoring evidence.
Rail-battery reports record which model each measured arm ran on.
